company: Keenable is building a web-search index for AI agents, a use case that differs from consumer search by emphasizing machine-readable retrieval and agent workflows.
Axios reported a $26 million seed financing led by Accel. The company has not publicly disclosed a valuation or operating metrics, so this profile does not infer either.
intelligence.why_it_matters: As AI agents take on more research and workflow tasks, reliable search and retrieval can become a meaningful infrastructure layer. The investment case remains early because public evidence on product adoption and differentiation is limited.
